name: wasm-crustache
description: High-performance Mustache renderer powered by Rust and WebAssembly

scripts.build:esm: pnpm exec tsc --project tsconfig.json --module ES2022 --moduleResolution Bundler --outDir dist/esm
scripts.build:cjs: pnpm exec tsc --project tsconfig.json --module CommonJS --moduleResolution Node --outDir dist/cjs --declaration false
scripts.build:types: pnpm exec tsc --project tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly --declarationDir dist/types --outDir dist/types
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm exec vitest run
